test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The teacher asked **that who** was absent.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **“that who was absent”** is grammatically incorrect because the use of **“that”** in this context is unnecessary and redundant.
 
• The correct form would simply use **“who”** to directly indicate the subject being referred to.
 
• The sentence should thus be revised to **“The teacher asked who was absent.”**
 
• This revision ensures clarity, proper grammar, and eliminates redundancy.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The teacher asked who was absent."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: “that whom”** – Incorrect because **“that”** is redundant, and **“whom”** is not appropriate in the context of the subject of the question.
 
• **Option 2: “which student”** – Incorrect as it changes the meaning and adds unnecessary specificity.
 
• **Option 4: “whose”** – Incorrect because **“whose”** indicates possession, which is unrelated to the sentence context.
